Whilst the music may not have been to everyone's taste (I've learnt in this job you can't please all of the people all of the time!) the food certainly was, thanks to Sandra Tiernan and Sue parrott who co-ordinated the efforts of several of our ladies to produce a magnificent spread.
The invitation cross-country event saw another catering triumph when Margaret Stroud and Sue Parrott took responsibility for providing runners and officials with a meal after the race.

Hot chilli-con-carné, french bread, buns and tea were served up after the race, thanks to the stirling efforts of Sue Parrott and Margaret Stroud, whilst Brian Gorman and the bar staff kept the spectators in good fettle with their usual refreshments.
